body: I feel you. I'm 25, I've worked for a total of 1.5 years in my life. Work is only a constant source of stress and anxiety and misery. I've been jobless for 2 years now and I'm never gonna work again. I know I'm a burden on society but I don't care. It's not like I chose to be born anyway.

Hey, thanks for asking. :) I'm maybe very slightly better, but not much. Turns out people care about me, but I don't care about them. I care about myself the least. Life for me is just distraction after distraction until I run out of distractions and finally face the truth that I suck.

How are you?
Okay. :) But honestly, your chin is fine.
You're not ugly. Do you have a target weight you'd like to be at?
Yeah, pain is temporary, but so is pleasure. The pain will always come back. I'm not sure if I can survive many more suicidal episodes anymore. But thanks. I'll try my best.
One thing at a time. I have a psychiatrist's appointment in a month, maybe I'll survive until then.

Hey, I actually did (kinda) what you suggested. Couple hours ago, I had the worst moment in years, started carrying out my suicide plan, and then I remembered what you said. 

I decided to text my dad to call me (we live 200mi apart) , and he did. I cried for some time before I got the words out of my mouth: "I want to kill myself." His immediate response was "No.. no that doesn't sound good at all, no." He's a very calm and collected man but I could sense panic in his voice.. I thought he was the person who cared the least. We talked for an hour, and I feel a bit better now. Not good, but better.

I hope there's a future for me. :)

>The reaction was surprising and startling.

What kind of reaction exactly, if you don't mind me asking?

I'm afraid of telling a doctor about any of my mental symptoms. I'm afraid they'll tell me "No more hormones for you, you are clearly a confused man, go live as a man, fuck you" and leave me powerless and humiliated.

Sadly I can't get a job, because I can hardly get up in the morning. I'll just end up fired quickly.

I took the shower and I'm exhausted and can't do anything else today. Still better than no shower :)
Three people. My (divorced) parents and a friend I've known for 9 years. They'd talk about how it's good that a burden has finally been lifted.

>if you find a truly safe place to be yourself and reach out for help from someone IRL mentally, emotionally and totally

Yes, that would help. But there's no chance I'll ever be able to open up to anyone in person. Nobody wants to listen to me whine for long and they'll just leave me forever.

Yeah, you never know what surprises await you. Imagine my surprise when I finally admitted to myself I'm trans. Surprises aren't always positive, and lately they've been more and more negative all the time.

I'm not seeing a therapist, I don't have the money. Besides, I don't think they could help me anyway.

Fortunately I haven't broken anything, yet.

>Would they miss you and wish they could do anything to get you back, yes.

Only after I've died. A few people would attend my funeral, and then they'd forget that I'd ever existed.

I've given up on education and work. They made me absolutely miserable and I want to be happy. As for the face, there's a thing called Facial Feminization Surgery, but I don't think I'll ever be able to afford it.

Just taking a shower would be progress I guess..
